baseline.signal: leave-one-out fraction of eligible PIT-industry constituents with positive causal r20
baseline.schedule: every fifth CY-006 market session after causal warm-up
baseline.selection: top 10 by signal descending then symbol
baseline.weights: equal within each weekly cohort; four overlapping cohorts

opportunity_set.definition: for each baseline signal date, hold the baseline Top-10 industry allocation counts fixed; eligible alternatives are frozen CY-006 eligible names in those exact PIT industries
opportunity_set.industry_allocation: exact baseline selected-name count per industry and date
opportunity_set.fallback: if fewer modifier-valid alternatives exist than the fixed industry count, retain baseline names in baseline order for unfilled slots
opportunity_set.purpose: change stock identity only; do not change the industry alpha or industry allocation

arm0_baseline.ranking: unchanged baseline signal descending then symbol

arm1_upper_limit_clean.ranking: revised_240 descending then symbol within each fixed date-industry allocation
arm1_upper_limit_clean.revised_240: sum causal log returns over trailing 240 stock sessions after excluding every historical upper-limit close and its next stock session
arm1_upper_limit_clean.historical_limit_semantics: repository-authoritative up_limit_price/limit_pct by board, status, and date
arm1_upper_limit_clean.missing_quality: use frozen baseline fallback only; never change formation horizon or exclusion window

arm2_low_max.ranking: max_return20 ascending then symbol within each fixed date-industry allocation
arm2_low_max.max_return20: maximum causal daily log return over the prior 20 sessions
arm2_low_max.missing_quality: use frozen baseline fallback only; never change lookback or threshold

arm3_optional_equal_rank.authorization: only if arm1 and arm2 each pass every candidate-level gate before any full replay
arm3_optional_equal_rank.ranking: equal average of same-date-within-opportunity percentile quality ranks; higher is better

parallel_planning_only.scope: rank existing Price-Volume-Path family-level gaps without new factors or outcomes

prohibited: Industry Diffusion signal, clock, horizon, breadth, weight, exposure, exit, cost, or execution change
modifier horizon, threshold, exclusion-window, sign, or weight search
Low Idio, Low Vol-of-Vol, Low Skewness, Quiet VWAP, habitat, regime, or exposure rescue
full replay of a candidate-level-failing arm
optional arm 3 unless both individual arms pass every frozen attribution gate
new factor discovery or large data acquisition
OOS, independent-confirmation, validation, live, or production claims
